columns.gaming_template|deviceidentity|devsessio: Text 9 chars long. Pattern AAADDDDDD. Unique per row. Example GPT100866.

columns.gaming_template|deviceidentity|modnum: Text 7 chars long. Pattern AAADDDD. Many unique values. Example MDL4476.
columns.gaming_template|deviceidentity|fwver: Version string 5 chars long. Pattern D.D.D. Example 9.1.3.
columns.gaming_template|deviceidentity|conntype: One of four values: Wireless 2.4GHz, Wired, Hybrid, Bluetooth. Lengths 5 to 15 chars.
columns.gaming_template|deviceidentity|wlrangem: Real number. Values roughly 5 to 20. Pattern D.D or DD.D.
columns.gaming_template|deviceidentity|wlinterf: Categorical level. Three values only: Low, Medium, High.
columns.gaming_template|deviceidentity|wlchanhop: Integer. All rows value 0. No variation.
columns.gaming_template|deviceidentity|wllatvar: Real number. Values 0.1 to 2.0. Pattern D.D or D.DD.
columns.gaming_template|deviceidentity|pwrrgbmw: Integer. Values mostly two or three digits. Examples 147, 115, 197.
columns.gaming_template|deviceidentity|mcresptim: Real number. Values 0.1 to 5.0. Pattern D.D or D.DD.
columns.gaming_template|deviceidentity|mcexecspe: Real number. Values 0.1 to 2.0. Pattern D.D or D.DD.
columns.gaming_template|deviceidentity|mctimacc: Real number. Values around 90 to 100. Pattern DD.D or DDD.D.
columns.gaming_template|deviceidentity|dpires: Integer. Lengths 3 to 5 digits. Many distinct values; common values in 10000 to 25000 range.
columns.gaming_template|deviceidentity|senstype: One of four values: Optical, Laser, PMW3389, PAW3399. Lengths 5 to 7 chars.
columns.gaming_template|deviceidentity|sensres: Integer. Lengths 3 to 5 digits. Many distinct values; common around 15000 to 25000.
columns.gaming_template|testsessions|sessionregi: Alphanumeric session registry code. Always 9 characters, format AAADDDDDD with prefix GPT. Uniquely identifies each test session.
columns.gaming_template|testsessions|stampmoment: Full timestamp with microseconds, pattern YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.ffffff. Records exact moment of session event.
columns.gaming_template|testsessions|devscope: Categorical device scope. Values: Headset, Keyboard, Gamepad, Controller, Mouse. Indicates which device type the session concerns.
columns.gaming_template|testsessions|cpuusepct: Floating point CPU utilization percentage. Values between 0.0 and 4.97. Measured during session.
columns.gaming_template|testsessions|memusemb: Memory consumption in megabytes. Integer values from 10 to 99. Represents memory footprint of process at the time.
columns.gaming_template|testsessions|driverstatu: Categorical driver status. One of Beta, Stable, Experimental. Reflects driver version maturity level.
columns.gaming_template|testsessions|fwupdur: Duration of firmware update process. Integer values e.g., 259, 196. Units not specified but likely seconds or milliseconds.
columns.gaming_template|testsessions|wlsignal: Wireless signal measurement. Values range from -30.0 (strong) to positive values up to 99.55. Negative values likely dBm, positive may be percent or RSSI.
columns.gaming_template|testsessions|battlevel: Battery charge level as integer percentage. Range 0 to 99. Represents remaining battery capacity.
columns.gaming_template|testsessions|battcapmah: Battery capacity rating in mAh. Integer values often three to four digits, e.g., 1919, 714. Denotes battery storage capacity.
columns.gaming_template|testsessions|battlifeh: Battery life measurement. Values like 92.0, 75.0, 36.0. Range roughly 36 to 100. Unit ambiguous between hours and percentage.
columns.gaming_template|testsessions|chgtimemin: Time required to charge battery in minutes. Values like 192.0, 83.0, 148.0. Range approximately 83 to 225.
columns.gaming_template|testsessions|qchgflag: Boolean flag indicating quick charge support or state. Value 1 = yes, 0 = no.
columns.gaming_template|testsessions|usbpwrline: Describes USB power delivery capability. Values like '7.5W', '5W', '10W', 'USB-PD...'. Indicates power line specification.
columns.gaming_template|testsessions|latms: Response latency measurement in milliseconds. Values range from 0.11 to 19.36. Represents delay in session.
columns.gaming_template|testsessions|inplagms: Input delay in milliseconds. Values from 0.53 to 14.89. Measures time between input and response.
columns.gaming_template|testsessions|pollratehz: Device polling frequency in Hertz. Common values: 125, 250, 500, 1000, 2000, 4000, 8000.
columns.gaming_template|testsessions|dbtimems: Time spent on database operations in milliseconds. Values like 8.06, 1.25. Range 0.0 to 9.99.
columns.gaming_template|testsessions|resptimems: System response time in milliseconds. Values between 0.1 and 5.0. Measures overall responsiveness.
columns.gaming_template|testsessions|clkregms: Clock register time measurement in milliseconds. Small decimal values e.g., 0.672, 1.959. Possibly clock offset or interval.

columns.gaming_template|mechanical|tacbumpmm: Real number. Format D.D. Range 1.5 to 2.5 mm. 11 distinct values.
columns.gaming_template|mechanical|tottravmm: Real number. Format D.D. Range 3.0 to 4.0 mm. 11 distinct values.
columns.gaming_template|mechanical|stabrattle: Text. 4-8 chars. Values: Minimal, Moderate, None.

columns.gaming_template|mechanical|capthkmm: Real number. Format D.D. Range 1.0 to 1.5 mm. 6 distinct values.

columns.gaming_template|mechanical|ergorate: Integer. Range 1 to 10. 10 distinct values. 1-2 digits.

columns.gaming_template|physicaldurability|tempr: Categorical level, 7-8 chars. Three values: Enhanced, Premium, Standard. No nulls.
columns.gaming_template|physicaldurability|humid: Categorical level, 7-8 chars. Three values: Enhanced, Premium, Standard. No nulls.

columns.gaming_template|physicaldurability|water: Four-char code, pattern AAAD. Values IPX0, IPX1, IPX2, IPX3. No nulls.

columns.gaming_template|physicaldurability|usbco: Integer cycle count, always 4 chars. Values range 1013-5000. Examples: 3005, 4473, 3942. No nulls.
